means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present, its value is greater than or equal to the min_rd parameter, its value divided by the div parameter (integer division, rounding down) is strictly greater than the current value of the per_line state field at the way chosen by the victim search, and that field's value is greater than or equal to 0. False otherwise. Only valid inside victim.bypass_when.
name: safe_bypass

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present, its value is greater than or equal to the min_rd parameter, its value divided by the div parameter (integer division, rounding down) is strictly greater than the current value of the per_line state field at the way chosen by the victim search, and that field's value is greater than or equal to 0. False otherwise. Only valid inside victim.bypass_when.
name: safe_bypass_v2

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present, the per_line state field at the way chosen by the victim search is greater than or equal to 0, and either the table entry is strictly greater than 73, or the table entry is greater than or equal to the min_rd parameter and its value divided by the div parameter (integer division, rounding down) is strictly greater than that state field's value. False otherwise. Only valid inside victim.bypass_when.
name: guarded_bypass

means: Evaluates the core bypass condition: true if the table entry at the index is present, AND either (its value >= force_rd) OR (its value >= min_rd AND its value / div > the current value of the per_line state field at the victim way AND that field's value >= 0). The final result depends on ChampSim's get_set_sample_category(set) c: If c == 1, returns false (Leader A: never bypass). If c == 2, returns the core condition (Leader B: bypass enabled). Otherwise, returns the core condition ONLY IF the global saturating selector state field is >= its midpoint (e.g., 512 for a 10-bit counter). Only valid inside victim.bypass_when.
name: duel_bypass

means: Reads ChampSim's get_set_sample_category(set) c. If c == 1, increments the global saturating selector state field (clamped at max). If c == 2, decrements the selector field (clamped at 0). Otherwise, does nothing.
name: update_bypass_duel

means: Reads the per_line state field at the visited way. If its signed value is greater than min, returns its value minus 1. Otherwise returns min.
name: clamped_dec

means: Reads the signed per_line state field at the visited way. If the value is less than or equal to 0, returns min (-11). Otherwise, if the value is greater than or equal to 11, returns 11. Otherwise, returns the value minus 1.
name: seesaw_damped_age

means: Evaluates the core bypass condition: false if the entry of the table at the index is absent or if the current value of the per_line state field at the victim way is less than 0. Otherwise, true if either (its value >= force_rd) OR (its value >= min_rd AND its value / div > the current value of the per_line state field at the victim way). The final result depends on ChampSim's get_set_sample_category(set) c: If c == 1, returns false (Leader A: never bypass). If c == 2, returns the core condition (Leader B: bypass enabled). Otherwise, returns the core condition ONLY IF the global saturating selector state field is >= its midpoint (e.g., 512 for a 10-bit counter). Only valid inside victim.bypass_when.
name: duel_safe_bypass

means: Reads ChampSim's get_set_sample_category(set) c. Returns true if c == 2. Returns false if c == 1. Otherwise, returns true if the global saturating selector state field is greater than or equal to its midpoint (e.g., 512 for a 10-bit counter), and false otherwise.
name: bypass_duel_enabled
